copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 添加 Resend 邮件通道:从 channels 分支复制适配器,注册进通道列表,安装固定版本的 @resend/chat-sdk-adapter,然后构建并运行测试。还会让你填写 Resend API 密钥、域名等,并将你的邮箱设为 owner,发一封欢迎邮件。
howto.when: 在你要求通过 Chat SDK 为 NanoClaw 添加 Resend 邮件集成,或想把邮件作为异步对话通道接入时触发。

say.text: 帮 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮件通道。
say.note: 开始复制适配器并注册通道。

say.text: 用 Resend 添加邮件功能,并配置我的邮箱为管理员。
say.note: 提示粘贴密钥并设置 owner。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 装 Resend 邮件,然后发封测试邮件给我。
say.note: 构建验证并发送欢迎邮件。

howto.what_en: Adds a Resend email channel to NanoClaw: copies the adapter, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, builds and tests, then prompts for credentials and wires your email as owner, sending a hello email.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Resend email channel to NanoClaw via Chat SDK, or want to integrate email as an async conversation channel.

say_en.text: Add Resend email channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and registering the channel.

say_en.text: Set up Resend email and make my address the owner.
say_en.note: Prompts for secrets and wires owner.

say_en.text: Add Resend email and send me a test email.
say_en.note: Builds, validates, and sends the hello.
